title: New operator designs for Halpern iterations with explicit rates under Hölder error bounds
summary: We investigate the asymptotic behavior of Halpern-type iterations applied to quasi-nonexpansive operators arising in best approximation problems over the intersection of finitely many closed convex sets in $\mathbb{R}^n$. Assuming a local decrease condition for the underlying operator and standard requirements on the stepsizes $(α_k) \subset (0,1)$, we first prove strong convergence of the Halpern sequence $x_{k+1} = α_k x_0 + (1-α_k) T x_k$ to the best approximation point $x^\star$ in the intersection set, that is, the metric projection of $x_0$ onto that set.
